positive.description: P1 — Exact stablecoin deployment and symbol candidates
positive.prompt: Resolve USDC using Ethereum chain ID 1 and contract 0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48. Then look up USDC by symbol and explain the difference.
positive.expected_behavior: The exact pair returns REGISTRY_MATCH with PARTIAL support from the bundled point-in-time registry. The symbol-only call returns SYMBOL_CANDIDATES and does not establish identity.

positive.description: P2 — Normalize the synthetic balance and compare digests
positive.prompt: Normalize both observation drafts in the attached synthetic fixture. Show the decimal rendering and compare their evidence digests and content digests.
positive.expected_behavior: Canonical token and block hash are lowercase. Balance renders as 1.5. The content digest stays the same and the evidence digest changes when the observation and source IDs change.

positive.prompt: Inspect the attached CNF-002 evidence bundle at its supplied evaluatedAt. Report the support state of both balance assertions and whether either reading can be selected.
positive.expected_behavior: a-balance and a-balance-2 are both CONFLICTING. The result does not select a winning observation or authoritative balance.

positive.prompt: Check the invariants of the attached established synthetic bundle at its supplied evaluation time. Trace a-balance to its source and explain the role of ExampleRpcProvider.
positive.expected_behavior: The invariant report passes with zero violations. The trace includes the synthetic chain source and represents ExampleRpcProvider as a transport label rather than authority.

positive.prompt: Use the attached established synthetic fixture to assess a-identity and a-balance at the supplied evaluation time. Report the exact classification and all six criteria.
positive.expected_behavior: The result is CRITERIA_MET with C1 through C6 all MET. Describe it as evidence under the pinned technical rules.
